overons.sub: Two hoteliers who saw the energy crisis in hospitality up close and decided things had to change.
overons.p1: Jacob de Graaff and Melle Pegman know hospitality from the inside. Both graduated from Hotelschool Den Haag, with years of experience at international chains such as Hilton, IHG, Apollo Hotels (now Leonardo Hotels) and Eden Hotels (now Leonardo Hotels). Together they built a network of hundreds of hotels through platforms such as Hotelprofessionals, Hotel Leaders Network and the Hotel Business Club.
overons.p2: In recent years, Jacob and Melle have delved deeply into the energy issues gripping hospitality. From stalled expansions due to grid congestion to the struggle with the gas-free transition. They heard the same stories from dozens of hoteliers.
overons.p3: The conclusion was clear: hospitality needs its own energy partner. Someone who speaks the hotelier's language, has the network and can combine technical strength. That is how Hospitality Energy Solutions came to be.
overons.jacobp: Hotelschool Den Haag · Hilton Amsterdam. Built the largest hospitality network in the Netherlands. Now applies his knowledge of the industry to help hotels with the energy transition.
overons.mellep: Hotelschool Den Haag · Club Med · Hilton. Expert in hospitality operations and business development. Translates complex energy issues into clear solutions for hoteliers.
overons.partnerp: Lemnion works exclusively with Stroomlijnen, the technical brain behind our energy solutions. With 25 years of experience in charging infrastructure and a team of specialists, Stroomlijnen ensures every system works flawlessly. From hardware to monitoring, from installation to 24/7 support.
overons.ignaciop: The technical brain behind the Stroomlijnen platform. 25+ years of experience in energy and charging infrastructure. Responsible for all hardware, software and system integration within Lemnion.
overons.jaccop: Commercial brain with in-depth knowledge of the energy market. Ensures every Lemnion solution is not only technically sound, but also financially attractive for hotels.
overons.ctah: Ready to get to know us?
overons.ctap: Plan a no-obligation conversation with Jacob or Melle. We would love to look at what is possible for your hotel.
